card.name: Partway through medical terms
card.fires_on: Fires on the ending or middle piece of a medical word that is still being spelled out, such as the 'ic' of Gastric, the 'ile' of Febrile or 'ive' of adjunctive. It also fires on a few other label words such as 'range' or 'defined'.

modes.label: Word endings
modes.description: The closing piece of an adjective like gastric, febrile, adjunctive or audiologic.

modes.label: Other label words
modes.description: Standalone words in label prose such as range, defined, maximal or Recommendations.

card.plain: It lights up on the last piece of a medical adjective when the word is just finishing, plus a few scattered label words.
